notes.title: Default Game Mode has been changed from Simulation to Arcade
notes.content:
[p][b]Default game mode has been changed from "Simulaton" to "Arcade".[/b]
Some players reported that they can't see fish or fish are spooky. 
Since the default game mode was simulation you had to behave more calm and slow during hunting
Now the default game mode is Arcade and new players can have a better experience.
You can change the game mode in settings, clicking the [b]pause[/b] button on the [b]top right corne[/b]r.[/p]
